---
format:
  typst: default
---

```{=typst}
#let navy = rgb("#1E2B55")
#let charcoal = rgb("#20262D")
#let slate = rgb("#596673")
#let mist = rgb("#D9DEE2")
#let sail = rgb("#F4F5F6")
#let pcss-gold = rgb("#F4C91D")
#let level-plus = rgb("#FFF4BF")
#let level-4 = rgb("#D5D9DC")
#let level-3 = rgb("#E2E5E7")
#let level-2 = rgb("#ECEEEF")
#let level-1 = rgb("#F5F6F7")

#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  flipped: true,
  margin: (top: 0.32in, bottom: 0.50in, x: 0.52in),
  footer: context [
    #set text(
      font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
      size: 6.8pt,
      fill: slate,
      hyphenate: false,
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 12pt,
      [#link("https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/")[#text(fill: navy)[CC BY 4.0]] - you may share and adapt with attribution to Andrew Andrade: #link("https://github.com/mrandrewandrade")[#text(fill: navy)[https://github.com/mrandrewandrade]]],
      [Page #counter(page).display("1 of 1", both: true)]
    )
  ]
)

#set text(
  font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
  size: 9.8pt,
  fill: charcoal,
  hyphenate: false,
)
#set par(leading: 0.52em, justify: false)

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 2.65in),
  column-gutter: 24pt,
  align: top,
  [
    #text(size: 25pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[The Way We Meet]
    #v(1pt)
    #text(size: 11.2pt, fill: slate)[Attention, connection, and making space for one another.]
  ],
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (0.58in, 1fr),
      column-gutter: 9pt,
      align: horizon,
      [#image("technology-department-emblem.svg", width: 0.54in)],
      [
        #text(size: 8.3pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons]
        #linebreak()
        #text(size: 7.7pt, fill: slate)[Port Credit Secondary School]
      ],
    )
  ],
)

#v(7pt)
#line(length: 0.62in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
#v(3pt)
#line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.4pt + navy)
#v(7pt)

#grid(
  columns: (1.2fr, 1fr, 1.2fr),
  column-gutter: 18pt,
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Presentations:] Weds., Sept. 16 & Thurs., Sept. 17, 2026],
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Value:] /10 - equal to Past, Present & Becoming],
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Submit:] completed listening notes after the final presentation day],
)

#v(7pt)
#text(size: 15pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Learning goal]
#v(2pt)
I can make space for another person by listening with attention, recording meaningful notes, contributing respectfully, and reflecting honestly on my own attention.

#v(7pt)
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 22pt,
  [
    #text(size: 14pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Being present for someone else]
    #v(3pt)
    - phones away unless directed otherwise
    - face the speaker and use attentive body language
    - avoid side conversations and other distractions
    - write one brief note for every presenter
    - listen for something you learned, noticed, or connected with
    - be ready to ask a question, make a comment, or share a connection
  ],
  [
    #text(size: 14pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Your listening notes]
    #v(3pt)
    For each presenter, record:
    #v(2pt)
    - something you learned or noticed
    - a connection, question, or comment
    - your own attention: #text(weight: "bold")[Attentive / Some lapses / Not attentive]
    #v(3pt)
    Short phrases are enough. The goal is evidence that you were actually listening, not long paragraphs.
  ],
)

#v(7pt)
#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: sail,
  stroke: (left: 4pt + pcss-gold),
  inset: (left: 12pt, right: 12pt, top: 7pt, bottom: 7pt),
)[
  #text(size: 10.2pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Be honest about your attention]
  #v(2pt)
  #text(size: 9.2pt)[An honest "Some lapses" or "Not attentive" is better than falsely claiming full attention. A lapse does not automatically mean zero. If your self-rating is knowingly inaccurate, the #text(weight: "bold")[Integrity & Reflection] score can be reduced more than the original attention lapse would have cost.]
]

#v(7pt)
#text(size: 14pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Learning Skills - how we meet one another matters]
#v(3pt)
#table(
  columns: (1.05fr, 2.25fr, 1.05fr, 2.25fr),
  inset: (x: 6pt, y: 5pt),
  stroke: 0.5pt + mist,
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Responsibility]], [brings the sheet, keeps phones away, completes and submits the work],
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Organization]], [keeps notes complete, readable, and in order],
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Independent Work]], [records notes without repeated reminders],
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Collaboration]], [listens respectfully and helps create a good audience for classmates],
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Initiative]], [offers thoughtful questions, comments, or connections],
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Self-Regulation]], [manages devices, impulses, distractions, and refocuses after a lapse],
)

#pagebreak()

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, auto),
  align: horizon,
  [#text(size: 18pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[The Way We Meet · /10]],
  [#text(size: 7.7pt, fill: slate)[Technology Commons · Port Credit Secondary School]],
)
#v(3pt)
#text(size: 8.5pt, fill: slate)[Each criterion is worth #text(weight: "bold")[2 marks]: 4+ = 2 marks · Level 4 = 1.5 marks · Level 3 = 1 mark · Level 2 = 0.5 marks · Level 1 = 0 marks.]
#v(6pt)

#table(
  columns: (1.16fr, 1.18fr, 1.28fr, 1.28fr, 1.20fr, 1.18fr),
  inset: (x: 5.5pt, y: 5.8pt),
  align: left + top,
  stroke: 0.5pt + white,
  fill: (x, y) => {
    if x == 1 { level-plus }
    else if x == 2 { level-4 }
    else if x == 3 { level-3 }
    else if x == 4 { level-2 }
    else if x == 5 { level-1 }
    else { white }
  },
  table.header(
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Criterion]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[4+ · 2 marks]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Level 4 · 1.5 marks]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Level 3 · 1 mark]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Level 2 · 0.5 marks]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Level 1 · 0 marks]],
  ),

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Attention & Presence] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[Were you genuinely listening?]],
  [Consistently attentive, respectful, and visibly engaged; quickly redirects any minor distraction.],
  [Attentive and respectful throughout with very few lapses.],
  [Generally attentive with some minor lapses that do not disrupt others.],
  [Attention is inconsistent; repeated distraction, device use, or side conversation is evident.],
  [Frequently disengaged, distracting, or not meaningfully listening.],

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Audience Notes] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[Did your notes show listening?]],
  [Complete, specific notes consistently capture meaningful details and connections.],
  [Complete notes capture clear details and useful connections for nearly every presenter.],
  [Most notes are complete and show reasonable attention to the presentations.],
  [Notes are incomplete, vague, or missing for several presenters.],
  [Very few usable notes are recorded.],

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Discussion & Connections] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[Did you help the conversation?]],
  [Thoughtful questions, comments, or connections consistently deepen discussion.],
  [Contributes relevant questions, comments, or connections when appropriate.],
  [Participates appropriately and makes some relevant contributions.],
  [Rarely contributes or contributions need significant prompting.],
  [Does not participate respectfully in discussion.],

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Completion & Consistency] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[Did you follow through?]],
  [Complete across all presentations and both days, with careful follow-through.],
  [Nearly complete and consistently maintained across the presentation days.],
  [Mostly complete with only a few gaps.],
  [Several gaps, missing sections, or repeated reminders are needed.],
  [Work is largely incomplete or not submitted.],

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Integrity & Reflection] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[Were your attention ratings honest?]],
  [Self-ratings are accurate, thoughtful, and show strong awareness of lapses and recovery.],
  [Self-ratings are honest and align well with notes and observed behaviour.],
  [Self-ratings are generally honest with minor inconsistency or limited reflection.],
  [Self-ratings are superficial, inconsistent, or need prompting to be accurate.],
  [Self-assessment is missing or knowingly inaccurate.],
)

#v(7pt)
#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: sail,
  stroke: (left: 3pt + pcss-gold),
  inset: (left: 10pt, right: 10pt, top: 6pt, bottom: 6pt),
)[
  #text(size: 9pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Integrity rule:] #text(size: 9pt)[Knowingly marking yourself "Attentive" when your notes or observed behaviour clearly show otherwise may result in #text(weight: "bold")[0/2 for Integrity & Reflection]. Honest acknowledgement of a lapse is treated more favourably than misrepresenting it.]
]
```
